'''Pakku''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served as a [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]]. He was assigned to the stormtrooper contingent aboard the [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Imperator (Imperial-class)|''Imperator'']] as of [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]].

==History==
Pakku was a member of the [[Platoon/Legends|platoon]] that had been assigned to [[Cadet Leader]] [[Kyle Katarn]] for Katarn's [[Omega Exercise]] and participated in the [[Battle of AX-456|ensuing battle]]. He was tasked by [[Sergeant major/Legends|Sergeant Major]] [[Hong]] to set some explosive charges before [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] reinforcements arrived.
